ai_language_tip: Match how staff answers: 'Moien' invites lb/de/fr, 'Bonjour' invites French (fr — dominant in restaurants/shops/salons!); English (en) works widely in Luxembourg City.
english_ok: often — Widely understood in Luxembourg City clinics, restaurants, hotels, and offices; French dominates cross-border service staff.
politeness: Open with 'Moien' (lb) or 'Bonjour Madame/Monsieur' (fr), use formal 'Dir' (lb) / 'vous' (fr) / 'Sie' (de); close with 'Merci, äddi' or 'Bonne journée, au revoir'.
name_tip: Surname and first name (e.g. Marc Schmit, Anne Weber); spell clearly since staff and callers span French, German, Portuguese, and English backgrounds.
phone_tip: Mobile 9 digits (621 123 456, 661..., 691...) read 3-3-3 or 3-2-2-2; landlines 8 digits (27 12 34 56) or shorter legacy numbers; SMS confirmation standard.
time_tip: 24-hour standard ('19h30' / '19:30 Auer'); watch Luxembourgish/German 'halwer aacht' = 7:30 vs French 'sept heures et demie' = 7:30! Always confirm 24h.
number_tip: In French, both standard soixante-dix/quatre-vingt-dix and Belgian septante/nonante are heard from cross-border staff—confirm digits cleanly.
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch rush 12:00–14:00, clinic lunch break 12:00–14:00, dinner rush 19:00–20:45, and calls after 20:00.
closed_days: Retail closes Sundays (except select Knauf/border malls); many restaurants close Sunday night and Monday; August collective construction leave (congé collectif).
booking_channels: Doctena (doctena.lu) dominates medical/dental; Salonkee (salonkee.lu) dominates hair/beauty; Zenchef/Resengo/TheFork for dining.
voice_menu: Hospitals (CHL/Hôpitaux Robert Schuman), CNS/CCSS, banks, POST/Tango, Luxair, and communes use multilingual keypad IVR.
callback_habits: Doctena, Salonkee, and Zenchef send automated SMS reminders 24h prior.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 盧森堡餐廳服務生多為法比跨境通勤者，法文（或英文）在餐飲業其實比盧森堡文更普遍；熱門餐廳常用 Zenchef 綁卡。

may_come_up.what: Staff answers in French only ('Bonjour') and doesn't speak Luxembourgish
Sends Zenchef SMS link for card pre-authorization

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number over phone

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 盧森堡醫師與牙醫高度普及 Doctena，電話掛號時秘書幾乎必問 13 碼社會保險號（Matricule CNS，內含生日）。
usually_asked: New or existing patient at the cabinet
Reason for consultation or dental issue
Preferred slot and language spoken by doctor

may_come_up.what: Missed-appointment fee (indemnité pour rendez-vous non excusé) warning
Directs routine bookings to Doctena.lu

sensitive_asked.what: Asks 13-digit Matricule national / CNS number or date of birth

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 盧森堡多數沙龍使用 Salonkee（卢森堡本土平台），電話與線上預約並行。

may_come_up.what: Directs caller to Salonkee.lu if card deposit required

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card digits over phone
Demands immediate Payconiq payment

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車廠（Garage）10～11月強制換冬季胎旺季極滿；汽車年檢（SNCT Sandweiler/Esch）須上官方網站預約。
usually_asked: Vehicle registration plate and make/model, or device model
Seasonal tire swap (pneus hiver), révision, or fault
Tire hotel storage status (gardiennage de pneus)

may_come_up.what: SNCT technical inspection must be booked on snct.lu
Courtesy car fee quoted per day

sensitive_asked.what: Asks handset PIN code
Demands advance transfer for parts

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 披薩、葡式烤雞（Churrasqueira）、壽司與中餐常接電話訂自取（à emporter），外送多走 Wolt 或 Wedely。

may_come_up.what: Delivery handled via Wolt or Wedely only

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card or Payconiq payment before cooking

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 獨立麵包甜點店（Fischer/Oberweis 分店或社區店）、書店與肉鋪可電話留貨；大商場走總機。

may_come_up.what: Holds unpaid item until closing (~18:00–19:00)

sensitive_asked.what: Holiday cake/catering order requires deposit in store

change.before_dialing_zh: 診所與美容院嚴格執行 24 小時前改退規定，逾時缺席醫師可開立未報銷罰單。

may_come_up.what: Unexcused <24h medical/salon cancellation fee applies

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks Matricule CNS to locate appointment

usually_asked: Question (hours, parking, dog policy, stock, language spoken)

may_come_up.what: Closed during August congé collectif

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 鄉鎮旅館（Moselle/Müllerthal/Ardennes）電話友善，市區商務飯店多有按鍵分機且需信用卡擔保。

may_come_up.what: Offers sending secure email link to enter credit card guarantee

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number over phone

activity.before_dialing_zh: 保齡球、室內網球/Padel與團體休閒可電話問，市政泳池或課程多走網站。

may_come_up.what: Directs court booking to club online app/portal

sensitive_asked.what: Requires online prepayment

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須給完整地址與 L-xxxx 4碼郵遞區號；注意每年 8 月營建工班有集體長假（Congé collectif），非急修難約。
usually_asked: Street, number, residence name, floor, and 4-digit postal code

may_come_up.what: Quotes steep Luxembourg call-out fee (déplacement) + hourly rate
Trades closed during August congé collectif except emergency

sensitive_asked.what: Asks residence digicode over phone
Demands bank transfer upfront

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫、美容（Toilettage）與寄宿皆需預約，跨境寄宿（法德比邊境）亦常查歐盟寵物護照與狂犬病疫苗。
usually_asked: Rabies, kennel cough, and EU pet passport + microchip

may_come_up.what: Waitlist for grooming 2–4 weeks ahead

sensitive_asked.what: Boarding requires advance bank transfer deposit

tracking.before_dialing_zh: POST Luxembourg、DHL、DPD 專線皆有語音選單；獨立門市、車行與乾洗店才適合直撥。

may_come_up.what: POST hotline uses multilingual keypad IVR

sensitive_asked.what: Asks PackUp pickup PIN code

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、電信（POST/Tango/Orange）、Enovos 電力與 Luxair 皆有多語按鍵 IVR 並要求 LuxTrust 或 GDPR 本人核驗。
usually_asked: Matricule, birth date, or client number

may_come_up.what: Keypad language menu + GDPR blocks assistant

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Matricule, birth date, IBAN/card, or LuxTrust OTP

transport.before_dialing_zh: 盧森堡大眾運輸免費，計程車（Webtaxi / Colux）費率高但機場（Findel）接送與租車行電話預約很穩定。

may_come_up.what: Quotes fixed Webtaxi eco/standard tariff vs meter

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card or license number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: atHome.lu 房仲電話約看房時，幾乎必先問工作合約（CDI 試用期過沒）與稅後月薪（須達房租 3 倍）。
usually_asked: Listing on atHome.lu / Immoweb and commune
CDI status (hors période d'essai) and household net income

may_come_up.what: Agency requires emailing dossier before scheduling visit

sensitive_asked.what: Asks 13-digit CNS matricule over phone
Requests deposit payment before viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 公社（Gemeng/Commune）與機關常有按鍵分機且個資限本人；私立托兒所（Crèche）可電話問名額。
usually_asked: Child age and chèque-service accueil eligibility question

may_come_up.what: Commune switchboard uses keypad routing or MyGuichet.lu appointment

sensitive_asked.what: Asks 13-digit Matricule national
